units.source_text: 大竹七段身穿带家徽的黑色罗纱短外褂。

en.t: Otake 7-dan was wearing a short black woolen haori marked with his family crest.

units.source_text: 今天，也许是有点随意，名人只穿着带刺绣家徽的短外褂。

en.t: Today, perhaps feeling somewhat informal, the Meijin wore only a short haori embroidered with his family crest.

units.source_text: 棋盘和昨天的也不相同。

en.t: The game board, too, was different from the one used yesterday.
